findings.text: "A Try it tab on /framework/ext/Refine/" is not a tab. It was added as a child page (`children: "try"`), and the Refine page shows no tab bar and no link to it on its first screen (layout.json tab_rows 0 at every width; shots/…-Refine/1200.png, top band). A reader on Refine can't find it.

None of the shots shows the page working. Every width shows "Couldn't reach Servex to list models" (shots/…-Refine-try/1200.png, card 1), so the model picker, the cleaned text, the seconds, the $ cost and "Run all" are all unproven. The new `/api/clean-test` route only goes live after a Servex restart. Prove one Clean and one Run all with a shot before merging.
The two button rows have no gap: "Clean" and "Run all" touch, and so do the three Save/Score buttons (shots/…-Refine-try/400.png and 1200.png).
The empty `$single`/`$all` boxes leave about 130px of blank padding at the bottom of card 1 before anything has run (shots/…-Refine-try/1200.png, card 1 band).

"Run all" puts a 4-column table (with whole paragraphs of cleaned text) into a card that is only about 600px wide, even at 3440 (empty 82%, widest 714px). Side-by-side results need more width than the reading measure allows.
One of everything (law 6): `score_all` in try/page.js re-types the word-overlap scorer that run.js already exports as `word_overlap_score`, and `label_provider` is exported but never used.

"Run all" and "Score all models" fire every model at once with `Promise.all`. That includes every local gguf, so the :8998 proxy may try to load several models together. "Score all" also has no cost cap: it runs models × examples calls on OpenRouter.
"Good clean text" is a one-line `input`, but a good clean text is several sentences long. It should be a textarea. The page also uses `alert()` for its errors.
files.jsonl adds `weight.jsonl`, which this change has nothing to do with.

The page has still never been seen working. Every width logs CORS failures on `/api/clean-test` and `/api/clean-test/examples` (shots/…-Refine-try/layout.json `errors`), and the first card says "Couldn't reach Servex to list models". So the model picker, the cleaned text, the seconds, the real $ and "Run all" (requirements 1 and 3) are all unproven. Servex needs a restart, then one shot of a Clean and one of a Run all.

The shots in `shots/` are stale. They were taken at 23:07, before the last edits (try/page.js at 23:14, Refine/page.js at 23:17), so they show neither the Try it link nor the button gap. I judged the current state from my own headless shots of :53105 at 1200 and 400. Re-shoot before merging.

"Try it" is a link, not the tab the owner asked for (requirement 1). The comment in Refine/page.js explains why: `tabs()` would replace the whole ladder. The link is visible on the first screen (fresh 1200 shot, the band under the intro), so a reader can find it. Accepted as a reasoned change from the owner's words.

There is about 140px of blank space between the two cards before anything has run. It comes from the empty `$status` `.pad`, `$single` and `$all` boxes (fresh shots at 400 and 1200, between "Clean something" and "Build a test set").
"Run all" draws a 4-column table of whole paragraphs inside the reading column, which is about 600px wide even at 3440 (layout.json: empty 82%, widest 714px). A side-by-side comparison needs `wide`.

Each click of "Score all models" appends another score table (`$examplesBox.append`) instead of replacing the last one. Also, files.jsonl still adds `weight.jsonl`, which has nothing to do with this change.

None of the shots shows the Try it page working (requirement 1, page 8). Every width shows "Couldn't reach Servex to list models", and there is no model picker, no result and no Run all table. layout.json `errors` lists a CORS block on `http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/clean-test` and `/examples` at all four widths. The likely cause is a Servex that has not been restarted onto this change, since the diff does add `cors` to both routes. After the restart, re-shoot with the picker filled and one Clean result shown, so the main ask is proven by a picture.

"Try it" is a child page reached by a link, not a tab (requirement 1 says "a Try it tab"). The reason is written in `Refine/page.js`: with `navigation: "tabs"` and one child, the ladder stopped rendering. The deviation is explained and the page has its own URL, so this is a note rather than a fix.

There is a big empty gap between the "Clean something" card and the "Build a test set" card (layout 7 / spacing). In shots/…-Refine-try/1200.png the gap is about 150px, because an empty `.pad` status box and two 0-height divs each take a flow gap (layout.json bands 4–6: share 0.03, 0, 0). Show these boxes only when they have content.

In "Build a test set", the label "Good clean text — what the clean step SHOULD have said:" runs straight on from the paragraph above with no rhythm break (flow 27/28). See shots/…-Refine-try/1200.png, bottom band. The label also sits closer to the paragraph than to its own textarea.
The Dictate mic is not mounted (requirement 1 allowed it only "if it mounts in one line"), and neither the page nor the readme says why. Add one line saying so.
`ext/Refine/files.jsonl` now also lists `weight.jsonl`. The file exists, but nothing else in this diff explains why it was added. Check that it was meant to be part of this change.
